scope: Synthetic engineering feasibility only; one independent reliability system per frozen RTMPose-S locator.
reason_for_bad15: TRAIN and CALIBRATION contained no BAD30 positives for two locators. BAD15 is frozen before untouched inference as a stricter, learnable risk event.

availability.threshold_rule: On CALIBRATION only: require unavailable recall >= 0.90 and maximize available recall.

bad15.threshold_rule: On CALIBRATION only: require BAD15 recall >= 0.80 and maximize safe-row acceptance.

preprocessing: training median imputation, then training mean/std scaling
